mapper.select: SELECT resource_id AS resourceId, title, description, material_type AS materialType, visibility, status, download_count AS downloadCount, like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS createdAt FROM resource WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, resource_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT f.id AS favoriteId, f.resource_id AS resourceId, r.title, r.material_type AS materialType, r.visibility, r.status, r.download_count AS downloadCount, r.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(f.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS favoritedAt FROM favorite f JOIN resource r ON f.resource_id = r.resource_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f JOIN resource r ON f.resource_id = r.resource_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
